description: This file is a test suite for the 'filterCardsAND' function, testing filter logic in a Kanban board application. It imports Jest functions for testing and defines multiple test cases to verify filtering behavior on a sample card dataset.

methods.name: filterCardsAND(cards, filters, columns)
methods.description: Filters a list of cards based on multiple filter criteria, including assignees, priorities, statuses, columns, and due dates. Returns only cards that satisfy all specified filters.
